name: Femi Aluko
script: Chowdeck yeah. Food and grocery delivery in Nigeria, Lagos first, then Ibadan, Abuja, Port Harcourt. Three of us started it. I'm CEO. We raised a seed from Y Combinator and others a while back, I think we're seed or series A, depends who you ask.
No wait you said seed? No. Series A. Fix it.
Team is around two hundred, maybe more with riders but they're not staff.
We want like, 10 to 15 million naira. No sorry, dollars. Ten million dollars.
Why does it matter what instrument, just write equity.
